note: Swedish uses the same nine-shaped ” to open and close; parity decides which end.

note: "ny rad" inserts a real newline; the surrounding "punkten" (inflected) is never a mark.

transcript: det var allt punkt tack för idag
exact: Det var allt. Tack för idag.
note: Bare "punkt" renders a period only where the noun reading is impossible.

transcript: han har en svag punkt
note: A determiner two tokens back shields the noun — "en svag punkt" is a weak spot.

transcript: vi går igenom det punkt för punkt
exact: Vi går igenom det punkt för punkt.
note: "punkt för punkt" is guarded from both sides; nothing renders.

transcript: det var bra. punkt
note: The transcriber already emitted the mark AND the speaker said it — no doubling.

transcript: andelen ökade till 12,5% i år
note: Svenska skrivregler §12.14.1: a space between the figure and %. The decimal comma survives the shared spacing pass.

transcript: temperaturen är 20°C ute
note: Same rule for the degree sign.

transcript: se kapitel 3, 4 och 5
note: A comma that arrived spaced is an enumeration, not a decimal — left alone.

transcript: han sa “hej” till mig
note: English curly quotes become the Swedish ”; straight " is left alone (code).

transcript: mötet är på Fredag i Juli
exact: Mötet är på fredag i juli.
note: Weekdays and months are common nouns in Swedish (Språkrådet) — lowercased mid-sentence.

transcript: vi behöver t.ex. det andra alternativet
exact: Vi behöver t.ex. det andra alternativet.
note: An abbreviation's period does not start a sentence; the shared capitalization pass is undone.

transcript: jag tar med bl.a. Anna och Erik
exact: Jag tar med bl.a. Anna och Erik.
note: Only function words are lowered after an abbreviation, so a proper noun is never eaten.

transcript: vad heter filen
note: Interrogative opener gains a question mark.

transcript: kan du kolla det
note: Swedish is V2: a finite verb in first position is a yes/no question.

transcript: var ligger filen
note: "var" is interrogative only when a finite verb follows it.

transcript: var snäll och skicka rapporten
note: Same word as an imperative — must stay a statement.

transcript: gör det nu
note: "gör" is excluded from the question openers because its imperative is spelled the same.

transcript: spara det som main punkt paj
note: "paj" is how a Swedish transcriber writes the spoken ".py"; no period is glued onto a file name.

transcript: max understreck försök är satt till fem
note: Identifiers join and keep the Swedish spelling; a leading identifier is not capitalized.

transcript: skicka till anna punkt svensson snabel-a exempel punkt se

transcript: drar ett streck i sanden

transcript: git status
note: Terminal category stays command-safe: no capital, no period, no rule fires.
